rollback_or_rollforward: Reversible: downgrade drops the tenant-isolation RLS policies (and disables FORCE/RLS) on every northstar_research table, then drops experiment_ref, dataset_ref, claim, evidence_record, research_revision, research_document, research_project, workspace and the northstar_research schema (CASCADE). research_revision holds immutable published revisions and claims/evidence hold org_research_confidential data, so on a shared environment export the schema first (uninstall policy export_then_delete) and restore from the pre-migration backup rather than dropping in place.

prechecks: database is a supported PostgreSQL version
postchecks: northstar_research schema with workspace, research_project, research_document, research_revision, evidence_record, claim, dataset_ref and experiment_ref tables exists
row-level security is enabled and forced on every northstar_research table with a tenant-isolation policy keyed to the northstar.tenant_id GUC

compatibility_window: Phase 3 research module (workspaces, evidence-backed claims, AI-assisted drafting, exports) baseline
